name: lutkepohl_poskitt
title: The echelon form: Lütkepohl and Poskitt's flour prices
summary: The echelon form on the data Lütkepohl and Poskitt (1996, §4.1) used to show it: monthly flour price indices in Buffalo, Minneapolis and Kansas City, 1972-1980, as rates of change, from the raw table on route V. The Kronecker indices are searched on the vector; sima's criteria choose (0, 0, 0) as theirs do, their (1, 1, 1) overfits, and their two restricted models of five coefficients come out with the same estimates and standard errors.
plan: N0c characterize — the rates of change (logs, d = 1), their transformation
N0v write_specs, N1 run_gate — route V: the vector first
N2 identify_echelon — the Kronecker indices: (0, 0, 0) by SC and HQ, (1, 1, 1) by AIC, as their Table 1
N3 estimate(indices=) — (0, 0, 0), then their (1, 1, 1): 18 coefficients, MA roots at 0.999
N3 simplify, estimate(zeros=) — their restricted VAR(1) and MA(1), five coefficients each (Table 2)
N4 check_residuals, N5 evaluate — clean residuals; out of sample, the univariates do as well
